name: Cloudflare
description: Static SPAs on Workers with static assets, and Next.js through Cloudflare's adapter.

specSections.title: Environments & Configuration
specSections.guidance: Per environment (production trigger on the default branch; preview = Worker versions of the version branch): the Worker name and URLs, build variables per trigger, runtime vars and secrets (runtime secrets are shared by preview and production), the origin model (proxy Worker with API_ORIGIN, or cross-origin with API_BASE_URL and CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS) and the backend URL each environment targets.

requiredEnv.description: The backend target URL for this environment; the frontend platform proxies /api/* to it (FR-146). Derived by AIDE.

true where the environment has its own database (production; preview when a preview database exists), else false. The build runs the data pack's migrate command only when true (FR-154, D-V4-13). Derived by AIDE.
requiredEnv.when: nextjsMode == full-stack && data != none && data != data-supabase && databaseHost != none

checklist.item: wrangler.jsonc has the Worker name, assets directory, single-page-application not-found handling and a real compatibility date
Proxy origin model: main points at the Worker, assets has binding ASSETS and run_worker_first ["/api/*"], and the Worker forwards /api/* to env.API_ORIGIN
No backend runs on Cloudflare, and no backend URL is hard-coded in the Worker or vars
Next.js full-stack migrations run only in the build gated by AIDE_RUN_MIGRATIONS
No API tokens or account ids in the repo; .dev.vars and .wrangler/ are git-ignored
No CI job, script or package script deploys with the Wrangler CLI; AIDE triggers every deploy
.env.example lists every variable the app needs, with placeholders only
